<section class="about">

  <div class="about-text">
    <p>I'm a theoretical physicist working where <strong>statistical mechanics</strong> meets
    <strong>machine learning</strong>. I use tools from the physics of disordered systems and random
    matrix theory to understand how neural networks learn: the geometry of their loss landscapes,
    the dynamics and implicit biases of gradient descent, and the origin of neural scaling laws.</p>
    <p>I'm completing my PhD at Sapienza University of Rome, and I will soon join the
    <strong>École Normale Supérieure</strong> in Paris as a postdoctoral researcher.</p>
